checks.what: Is the answer in the first 150 words?

findings.message: A substantive, quotable answer appears within the first 150 words.

checks.label: JSON-LD schema
checks.what: Structured data an engine can parse.

findings.message: Only supporting types found (Organization, WebSite, WebPage). No Article/FAQPage/Product markup.
findings.fix: Add a high-value type that describes the page content itself, not just the site.

findings.message: No author anywhere — not in schema, not as a visible byline.
findings.fix: Add a visible byline and an author node in schema.

findings.message: No published or modified date anywhere in the markup.
findings.fix: Show a visible date and mirror it in schema — freshness is a citation signal.
Turn at least your key sections into question headings with a direct answer in the first paragraph below.

findings.message: No Q&A-shaped content at all — nothing here maps onto a user's question.
findings.fix: Add a FAQ section (with FAQPage schema) covering the 3–5 questions this page should win.

findings.message: Text-to-HTML ratio is 2.3% (890 words in 243 KB).
findings.fix: Cut wrapper markup, inline scripts and boilerplate; more of each byte should be content an engine can use.

findings.message: No llms.txt. Optional / low current yield — small penalty only.
findings.fix: If you want it: add /llms.txt with a markdown summary of your site's key pages.
